name: Senso Electronics
description: A calm, cinematic brand-site storefront for an electronics shop: a clear header over a full-bleed hero carousel, product families with clean mega panels, featured and lifestyle image cards with pale category tiles, offers and new-arrival rails, line-icon category tiles, stories and a newsletter; dark category banners with kinds, a filter card and three-a-row cards with Learn more; a product page with a sticky info column, Highlights bands, a two-column spec table and Compare with similar; and a support centre, cart, checkout and account in the same dress.
